malariafwd v0.1.0 — validation

Source: VALIDATION.md

How the model is checked: the validation scripts and what each found, and the numeric audit of the recombination machinery. The model description says what the model does, and its section 13 gives which parameters are calibrated to data and which are not.

Validation suite

inst/validation/ ships five scripts: assertion checks on a run’s event log and genealogy, the calibration of NU_HYPNOZOITE_BATCH, and two numeric audits of the recombination machinery. inst/validation/RESULTS.md records the last full run — its date, commit and versions, and how many checks each script passed. The counts are there rather than here, so that they come from a run rather than from editing by hand.

script what it checks
audit_events_and_ibd.R event-log integrity, transmission links, the ARG and IBD, and genotype painting, on each of three configurations
check_parameters.R that the structural invariants hold across 34 configurations, and that each parameter moves the model the way it should
calibrate_nu.R that every run completes, that the shipped ν does not die out, and that it sits inside all four targets; it makes the table below
audit_arg_recombination.R a numeric audit; see below
audit_arg_junctions.R a numeric audit; see below

Event-log integrity

audit_events_and_ibd.R runs three configurations of 80 hosts and 160 mosquitoes for 400 days, with 8 founder lineages: biting at 0.12 with one oocyst an uptake and one genotype a bite, every other setting at its default; the same with several oocysts an uptake, negative-binomial counts, several products a bite and imports; and biting at 0.16 with several oocysts, blood-stage treatment whose failures recrudesce and radical cure. The observed column gives the three in that order.

property expectation observed

creation events mint unique pedigree_ids no reuse 577, 977 and 1,085 created, all distinct
each inoculation_id is one bite 1 tick, 1 host 197, 269 and 403 bites
no batch draws more hypnozoites than it held 0 over-draws 150, 242 and 321 batches, 0 over-drawing
every activation references an established batch 100% 218, 362 and 265 activations
unresolved hypnozoites == final reservoir in state.tsv exact match 230 vs 230; 313 vs 313; 282 vs 282
each uptake has its own oocyst_id unique 1,328, 4,896 and 5,945 oocysts
oocysts per blood meal ≥ 1; 1 at λ = 0 mean 1.00 (max 1), 2.94 (max 22) and 3.05 (max 28)
recombinant uptakes record two distinct parents always 9.4%, 23.9% and 13.0% recombinant

The over-draw check guards the retirement of exhausted batches, which the Eidos scoping trap in the implementation notes would break silently: an unretired batch keeps activating after it has run out.

Recombination machinery audit

property expectation observed
all 13 chromosome junctions used yes yes
junction share of crossovers 26.6% (6.5 junction vs 17.9 within per product) consistent
within-chromosome breakpoint density uniform across chromosomes CV ≈ 0 CV = 0.008 (7,376–7,628 per Mb)
within-chromosome breakpoint position uniform KS p > 0.05 D = 0.002, p = 0.799
a product’s parent across a junction (independent assortment) φ ≈ 0 φ = 0.01 ± 0.03 at 50.4% the same
a product’s parent across 200 kb within a chromosome φ = e^(−2r × 200 kb) = 0.744 φ = 0.712 at 85.6% the same
IBD segments two products of one oocyst share (two unrelated founder parents) mean L/(14 + 2rL) = 0.49 Mb, 16.6 a pair 0.48 ± 0.02 Mb, 16.8 a pair (85 pairs from 45 oocysts)
IBD segments a product shares with its parent mean L/(14 + rL) = 0.76 Mb, 16.0 a product 0.78 Mb, 15.9 a product (100 products; KS p = 0.07 against the map)

Segments are counted as the derived metrics define them, with no length floor. Where two products of one oocyst carry the same parent they carry its two chromatids, so every chiasma (rate 2r) ends a shared stretch, and where they differ one begins at rate r; a product against its parent changes only at a crossover (rate r).

The junction-vs-control contrast, measured on each product against its parent (φ about 0 against 0.71), is the direct evidence that independent assortment is working: a product’s parent at the end of one chromosome says nothing about the start of the next, while within a chromosome it stays linked over 200 kb. Pooled over pairs of products of one oocyst the IBD state is correlated across junctions (φ about 0.09 expected), because meiosis I pairs the products alike on every chromosome.
